summary: Created idempotent scrapers/apply_unknown_reports.py and ran v2 apply of unknown-games fleet reports into owner_attested.json. Re-confirmed first-pass work (185 add_games, 21 closed, 101 exclude). Newly applied 22 confirmed_none certain excludes with non-circular evidence on other-only venues. Rebuild dropped other-only 2024->2002 and arcades 11856->11848. Pure-other has_games and low-confidence verdicts remain skipped (safety over coverage).
how_to_verify: Inspect data_raw/unknown/apply_plan_v2.json for n_exclude / skipped reasons
Count research-fleet excludes in data/owner_attested.json (expect 123 + 2 owner excludes = 125 exclude flags)
risks: confirmed_none excludes drop pins; circular ZIv-empty is filtered but agent notes can still be wrong.
has_games pure-other-only is always skipped (map chip is already other; writing add_games=['other'] is noise).
sid join depends on current arcades.json; missing sids after a prior exclude are matched via synthetic ziv/bemanicn keys.
Owner-attested entries are protected from research-fleet overwrite except certain real-game lifts.
likely confirmed_none (430) and likely closed (12) are intentionally not applied.
